sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-09-30)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the CC packs whose race is Falmer, Chaurus, Chaurus Reaper, Chaurus Hunter, Frozen Falmer or Frozen Chaurus, or whose factions include `FalmerFaction` 02997E, `ChaurusFaction` 03C9A8 or `dunBlackreachFalmerServantFaction` 0B2D37, followed through every `LVLN` and template that points at them. Re-checked 2026-11-12: every Falmer-race record that keeps its own level is on a family page or below. Vanilla has no named Falmer: the only individually placed Falmer boss is the Forgotten Vale Warmonger, on *Falmer Boss*. Everything found is on a family page except the following.
